name: Aisera
tagline: Agentic AI platform for IT, HR, and customer service desks.
description: Aisera is an enterprise agentic AI platform that automates service interactions across IT, HR, finance, and customer support. It resolves and deflects tickets autonomously using domain-specific 'Hyperflows' and prebuilt templates, with tools like Agent Composer and LLM Studio to configure conversational and back-office automation in one loop.
insight: Acquired by RPA company Automation Anywhere in 2025 to pair its service AI with agentic process automation.

modelSupport.notes: LLM-agnostic; LLM Studio configures and routes across multiple models for resolution.

edge: Ships domain-tuned Hyperflows and is trained on 400M+ service interactions, so it resolves tickets end-to-end rather than just routing them.
pros: Spans IT, HR, finance, and CX
